articles.title: OpenAI Releases GPT-5 Turbo with Native Multimodal Reasoning Across Six Modalities
articles.summary: OpenAI launched GPT-5 Turbo, which natively processes text, images, audio, video, 3D assets, and structured data within a single unified architecture. The model demonstrates substantial gains on ARC-AGI-2 benchmarks and introduces persistent memory across sessions, marking a significant step toward more general-purpose AI systems. Enterprise API pricing dropped roughly 40% compared to the original GPT-5 release earlier this year.

articles.title: Google DeepMind's Gemini Ultra 2 Achieves State-of-the-Art on Graduate-Level Scientific Reasoning
articles.summary: DeepMind published results showing Gemini Ultra 2 scoring above 90% on GPQA Diamond across physics, chemistry, and biology, surpassing domain-expert human baselines in several sub-categories. The model uses a new mixture-of-experts architecture with over 50 specialized expert modules that dynamically activate based on query domain. Researchers highlighted its ability to generate and verify multi-step mathematical proofs with minimal hallucination.

articles.title: Tesla Optimus Gen 3 Begins Limited Deployment in BMW and Amazon Warehouses
articles.summary: Tesla's Optimus Gen 3 humanoid robot has entered pilot deployment at select BMW manufacturing plants and Amazon fulfillment centers, performing bin picking, parts transport, and light assembly tasks. The new generation features 28 degrees of freedom in each hand and a significantly improved vision-language-action model trained on over 100,000 hours of teleoperation data. Early reports indicate the units can operate autonomously for 6-hour shifts with a task completion reliability above 94%.

articles.title: Figure AI Raises $1.5B Series C as Its Humanoid Robot Demonstrates Generalized Tool Use
articles.summary: Figure AI closed a $1.5 billion Series C round at a $15 billion valuation after demonstrating its Figure 03 robot using previously unseen hand tools by interpreting natural language instructions and inferring grip mechanics in real time. The system leverages a foundation world model jointly developed with Microsoft that enables sim-to-real transfer with minimal fine-tuning. The company plans to scale manufacturing to 1,000 units per month by mid-2027.

articles.title: Anthropic Introduces 'Constitutional Classifiers 2.0' for Real-Time AI Safety Monitoring in Production
articles.summary: Anthropic released Constitutional Classifiers 2.0, an open-weight safety monitoring layer designed to sit alongside any LLM deployment and detect harmful outputs with sub-10ms latency overhead. The system uses a distilled classifier trained against Anthropic's constitutional AI principles and supports customizable organizational policies. Early adopters report a 75% reduction in flagged outputs escaping content filters compared to previous rule-based approaches.

articles.title: TSMC Begins Volume Production of 1.4nm GAA Process Node for Next-Generation AI Accelerators
articles.summary: TSMC announced volume production on its N1.4 process using second-generation gate-all-around transistors at its Fab 20 in Tainan, with initial wafers allocated to NVIDIA's next-generation Blackwell Ultra GPUs and custom AI accelerators for major hyperscalers. The node delivers approximately 25% better performance per watt compared to N2, with transistor density exceeding 250 million per square millimeter. This advancement is expected to meaningfully reduce the cost-per-token for large-scale AI inference workloads starting in early 2027.

articles.title: Meta Open-Sources Llama 4 Behemoth with 1.2 Trillion Active Parameters Under Permissive License
articles.summary: Meta released Llama 4 Behemoth, its largest open-weight model with 1.2 trillion active parameters in a mixture-of-experts configuration totaling nearly 5 trillion total parameters. Benchmarks place it competitive with GPT-5 and Gemini Ultra 2 on coding, reasoning, and multilingual tasks, making frontier-level capabilities broadly accessible. The model is released under a revised Llama Community License that permits commercial use for organizations with under $10 billion in annual revenue.

articles.title: Solid-State Battery Startup QuantumScape Ships First Commercial Cells to Volkswagen EV Production Line
articles.summary: QuantumScape confirmed its first commercial shipment of solid-state lithium-metal battery cells to Volkswagen's Salzgitter gigafactory for integration into a next-generation EV platform launching in 2027. The QSE-5 cells reportedly achieve 450 Wh/kg energy density and can charge from 10% to 80% in under 12 minutes while maintaining over 90% capacity after 1,000 cycles. This milestone represents the first large-scale automotive deployment of solid-state battery technology after over a decade of industry development.
